merge_queue.note: Reported by .github/workflows/ci.yml jobs typescript, rust-check, and bundle-check on pull_request and merge_group.

promotion_model.build_once: cd-npm-cli.yml job stage and cd-pwa.yml job build upload the npm tree, Pages dist, and release metadata. Later jobs download those artifacts.
promotion_model.main_ci_gate: Before preview jobs, cd-main-ci-gate.mjs requires a successful ci.yml push on main for the same commit with TypeScript, Rust, and Bundle budgets all success.
promotion_model.preview: After main CI passes, Preview publish jobs select environment Preview (no required reviewers) and publish 0.0.0-alpha.N on dist-tag alpha using environment secret NPM_TOKEN via publish-npm-package (NODE_AUTH_TOKEN and .npmrc), otherwise OIDC trusted publishing under the same environment. The github-pages deploy runs automatically with no GitHub environment approval.
promotion_model.preview_smoke: Before Production, cd-preview-smoke.mjs resolves @opensesame-labs/cli@alpha, runs opensesame --version, and (PWA CD) verifies the live Pages deploy for the commit.
promotion_model.profile_proof: cd-pwa.yml job proof must succeed (four install profiles) before build and Production.
promotion_model.production: When every gate passes, Production downloads the same staged artifacts, verifies live Pages again, rewrites package.json from 0.0.0-alpha.N to 0.0.0-next.N, and publishes that version with OIDC npm publish --tag next --provenance (empty npm token). It does not use NPM_TOKEN and does not run npm dist-tag add. The job selects environment Production so the npm trusted publisher can bind to it. No required reviewers on Preview or Production.
promotion_model.failure: Any gate failure skips Production and promotion_failed posts a commit comment via cd-promotion-notify.mjs.
promotion_model.pages_split: github-pages is the live Pages deploy (actions/deploy-pages). It is not the Preview environment. deploy-pages preview:true is not available to the public, so there is no second Pages environment. Do not add required reviewers to github-pages.

github_environment_changes_via_gh.production_required_reviewers: remove rule 70926080; Tyler removed required reviewers (2026-11-02)
github_environment_changes_via_gh.github_pages: keep branch policy main only (rule 62085543). No required reviewers and no wait timer.
github_environment_changes_via_gh.npm_token: Preview npm publish jobs (cd-npm-cli.yml preview, cd-pwa.yml npm_preview) select environment Preview and pass secrets.NPM_TOKEN to publish-npm-package (NODE_AUTH_TOKEN + .npmrc). When NPM_TOKEN is empty, the same job uses OIDC trusted publishing under environment Preview. Production selects environment Production and publishes 0.0.0-next.N with OIDC only. Production does not read NPM_TOKEN.

environments.name: Preview
environments.note: Preview npm publish binds here for NPM_TOKEN. Delete required-reviewer rule 70926078 so a leftover reference cannot wait. See github_environment_changes_via_gh.

secrets.NPM_TOKEN: Publish-scoped npm token for Preview alpha publish. cd-npm-cli.yml job preview and cd-pwa.yml job npm_preview pass secrets.NPM_TOKEN to publish-npm-package.
Unused by current Production jobs. Production publishes 0.0.0-next.N with OIDC trusted publishing, not an NPM_TOKEN dist-tag update. A publish-scoped token cannot change dist-tags (E401).

environments.name: github-pages
environments.role: Automatic live Pages deploy of the immutable artifact from cd-pwa.yml job deploy. Not the Preview environment. No second Preview Pages environment: actions/deploy-pages input preview is not public.

protection_rules.note: Do not add required reviewers. Production promotion is gated in workflow jobs, not by environment approval.

environments.name: copilot
environments.note: Existing environment; not referenced by new CD workflows. Reserved for Copilot/automation integrations.

npm_versioning.bump: increment the numeric suffix on 0.0.0-alpha.N from the npm registry

dist_tags.production_promotion: next on 0.0.0-next.N (same numeric suffix), OIDC publish, never latest

npm_packages.name: @opensesame-labs/web-pwa
npm_packages.payload: Built static dist (HTML, JS, WASM, manifest, service worker) from the same production Pages build uploaded to GitHub Pages

npm_trusted_publishing.oidc_fallback: Preview publish selects environment Preview. It uses secrets.NPM_TOKEN when set, otherwise id-token: write and npm publish --provenance under that environment. Production publishes 0.0.0-next.N with OIDC only (npm-token empty) under environment Production. Production does not use NPM_TOKEN or npm dist-tag add.
npm_trusted_publishing.recommended: Configure npm trusted publishers for each @opensesame-labs package (see publishers[]). Preview rows set environment to Preview. Production rows set environment to Production. Allow npm publish.
npm_trusted_publishing.first_publish: Trusted publishing supports the first npm publish once the publisher row exists. Until then, configure NPM_TOKEN on environment Preview. Production always uses OIDC under environment Production.
